latestVona.title: Semeru - 20260913/2253Z
latestVona.text: Eruption with volcanic ash cloud at 2253 UTC (0553 local). Best estimate of ash-cloud top is around 14323 FT (4476 M) above sea level or 2560 FT (800 M) above summit. May be higher than what can be observed clearly. Source of height data: ground observer. Ash cloud moving from north to northwest. Volcanic ash is observed to be gray. The intensity of volcanic ash is observed to be thick..
